title: Admit delayed carrier retirement to the full logical BIT recursion
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The changed downstream compensation saves one local recursive query (2913 → 2912) and 58 unit ADDs. The new owner/controller admission assigns all 126,144 helper occurrences and charges every idle return. The full nine-stage, 32-replica template therefore uses **902,592 paid requests instead of 902,880**, with unchanged rank mass 1,808,352 and live stock 28,416. Both original rank-two helper queries remain.

The new Catalogue/Topology adapter binds this word to the retained all-size **logical `p=1` caller**, including the current source50 reads, arbitrary dirty inputs, coefficient grammar, complete spectator packets, compatible row stock, private cleanup, active ancestors and logical storage. The proof gives `< 11 V_root + F_q'` live logical symbols on its stated canonical, root-coupled domain.

After conservative BIT fallback, the matched moment root improves from `(0.001737388318390108294399, 0.001737388318390108294400)` to `(0.001737631818486007553483, 0.001737631818486007553484)`. The separating rate `b=139/80000` gives the actual logical bound

```
T(n,w) <= 200 C n + 2400000 C n^(1-b) w.
```

Here `T` is logical Tape work normalized by fresh-row payload. The constant `C` is uniform on the stated input domain for fixed prime `q > 2^80`; it is not the finite scalar invoice coefficient. This improves the sufficient power bound; it does not order total invocations or runtimes at every finite width. At parent width 640 the new rank-seven child has width 70 and recurses, while the removed rank-six child had width 60.

The finite invoice includes 5,760 additional returned idle ranks, source selectors, chart inverses, bridges and private work under its retained implementation contracts and selector-factorization prime exclusions. Scalar envelopes are charged at 128/256 bits, with a 512-bit depth-two allowance; these are separate from variable address precision `w`. Those historical selector exclusions do not restrict the actual logical caller's dyadic routes. Fixed physical-tape lowering, stronger primitive tariffs, exact rounded-child cleanup and outer assembly remain open. **No new selected κ is claimed:** the unchanged complex supplier remains limiting.

[Admission and next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1/research/bit-carrier-owner-admission/README.md) · [Caller proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1/research/bit-carrier-owner-admission/CALLER-PROOF.md) · [Independent source review](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1/research/bit-carrier-owner-admission/CALLER-REVIEW.md) · [Complete recurrence](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1/research/bit-carrier-owner-admission/RECURSION.md).

## Task and overlap

User-assigned recursive admission of PR4183; catalogue card `bit-new-register-model` is retained with declared changed scope. Scientific base: `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`. The admission package pins the original local result at `928066009267fb32ab2c1a29b50fa3093ea18aef`; its source package and integer-output-preserving variant remain unchanged.

- [PR4068](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4068), `5a34918402ae2c0c683d8820ad832970e77f6382`: the shared-source packet.
- [PR4021](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4021), `c01f97ecfc7fa64847f6abd8f7b231e1df8c7b70`: five rank-four terminals; their returned idle work is now admitted and paid.
- [PR4179](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4179), `de9deae2b787143923c0a504fbcc3871d01cff0b`: its fixed complete-join floor is unaffected; this changes downstream compensation.

The final overlap refresh at 13:04 UTC on 2026-10-20 covered 312 open PRs and 2,709 Discussions with complete pagination, plus local metadata. These title/body matches are leads, not a novelty certificate. Exact source pins and retained caller/component notices are included.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-carrier-owner-admission
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-carrier-owner-admission --check-source-history
```

At commit `59a1d97a86ea82b4d62958d705709ea46d7509f1`, both complete registered modes (normal and optimized Python), committed-byte/source-history checks and metadata/source pins passed. The committed export passed integrity checks and the complete normal replay in a fresh, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free tree.

Coverage includes independent serialized owners, all 660 signed input columns, both orientations/inverse orders, complete 5/9/11-stage Boolean columns, source-cut restoration controls and two independent rational interval methods. The caller checks all 11,193,984 candidate literal events, 549 split bases and 444 exact chart identities, plus Consumer/route/threshold bindings. Frame fixtures execute the actual context/return machinery with controlled 23-bit child bodies and test-only stock 11; they do not run the enormous complete compatible-stock GL64 payload. The all-parameter claim uses the written induction. The four threshold fixtures additionally check 391,086 complete ordered events against uncached reference goldens. Only those finite fixtures memoize repeated addresses; this checker acceleration does not enter production cost or storage claims. The caller and registered-command limits remain 540 and 600 seconds.

Fresh unchanged C++ legality/cohort checks passed for both native words. The old 104-bit scalar checker rejects both with `payloadfiniteprefix2^104`; that is a rejection control, not a passing historical H1–H5 replay. Portable replay does not invoke C++. No formal-kernel proof or full physical multiplication theorem is claimed. Hosted CI is reported separately on the published commit.

## Credit

Retain Ali Romman's R438/PR1043 source; Sagar Thakrar's allocation/windows; commdata2338's projector census; CubeJerry's native rehost; cheesegrader's framed owners; PR540/589 hosting and the retained controller authors; Jose Manuel's complete packets and compatible stock; David Arias's executable recursive caller; and the prior five-terminal charts. The original package retains its earlier kernel-entrance and R437-carrier credit.

Ross Richardson, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, writing and separate AI reviews. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0; frozen sources and notices are unchanged.

## Open next questions

Lower the logical tapes and arenas to fixed physical tapes with paid access and head/template return; supply stronger route/leaf costs and exact rounded COPY cleanup; then bind the outer wrapper and address the limiting complex supplier. The package README and TASK.json give the concrete starting points and blockers.
